name: band high knee lunge with single arm row
description: A lunge that finishes with a high knee, combined with a one-arm band row. It builds leg strength and balance.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Step back into a lunge and lower until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push through your front foot and drive the rear knee up to hip height.
Row the handle to your ribs while balancing on one leg.
Return to the start under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.
